title: Sacrifice Valley
description: Known as the 'Holy Mountain,' Sacrifice Valley draws thousands of Marian devotees during Holy Week to its Stations of the Cross and 'Nature's Basilica.' The provincial and municipal government are developing it as a tourism hub.

title: Roosevelt Protected Landscape
description: Nearly 786 hectares of grassland and old-growth forest shared with neighboring Dinalupihan, offering hiking trails, birdwatching, and picnic areas within a nationally protected landscape.

title: Agro-Industrial Hub
description: The Hermosa Ecozone Industrial Park and Subic-Hermosa Cybercity position the municipality as a growing center for manufacturing, logistics, and investment within Bataan's 1st District.

title: Seal of Good Local Governance
description: Hermosa was recognized with the DILG's Seal of Good Local Governance in 2024, reflecting strong performance in financial administration, disaster preparedness, and social protection.
